info.title: OptiFlow Platform API
info.description: RESTful services for the OptiFlow bounded contexts.

post.description: Public route registered in Mercado Pago. It checks the x-signature header, reads the notified payment and records it: an approved payment pays the sale and a rejected one keeps it pending. Repeated notifications are ignored.

200.description: Notification received, so the gateway does not send it again.

401.description: The signature of the notification is invalid.

503.description: The payment could not be read from the gateway; it will retry.

statusDetail.description: Reason given by the payment gateway, for example cc_rejected_insufficient_amount. Empty for cash payments.

amount.description: Amount received in cash; it must match the quotation total.

id.description: Id of the preference in Mercado Pago.

initPoint.description: Link that opens Checkout Pro, where the patient pays with card or Yape.

id.description: Id of the payment in Mercado Pago.

comment.example: Me atendieron rápido y los lentes quedaron perfectos.

message.example: Tus lentes están en control de calidad.

scheduledAt.description: Date a reminder is sent; null for the other notifications.

readAt.description: Null while the notification is unread.

appointmentId.description: Appointment of a reminder, if any.

workOrderId.description: Work order of an order notification, if any.

answeredAt.description: Null until the survey is answered.

minimumStock.description: New minimum stock of the frame in the store. When omitted, a new stock starts with 5 and an existing one keeps its minimum.

saleId.description: Only filled in the exits of a sale.

performedBy.description: Staff member who registered it; empty in the exits of a sale.

tryOnModelUrl.description: URL of the 3D model used by the virtual try-on.

quantity.description: Only filled when opticalStoreId is given.

minimumStock.description: Only filled when opticalStoreId is given.

totalAmount.description: Amount of the receipts of the closed sales.

averageTicket.description: Total amount divided by the closed sales.

ordersByStatus.description: Current status of the orders created in the period.

averageFabricationHours.description: Average hours from the creation of an order until it was ready for delivery, for the orders that became ready in the period.

delayedOrders.description: Orders whose delay was reported in the period.

lastBirthdayDiscountYear.description: Null until the first birthday discount.

low.description: True when the quantity is at or below the minimum stock.

bearerAuth.description: JWT obtained from POST /api/v1/auth/tokens. Send as: Authorization: Bearer <token>
